catalog.openfigi_lookupSummary: Find a listing by name or ticker. When you search listings on the Following page, or the assistant looks one up, this computer sends the search text to OpenFIGI, which also receives your IP address. Nothing is sent while you type. A personal key is optional. To get a key, provide your phone number, company, job title, industry and business address.
catalog.koreainvestment_market_dataSummary: Prices and market data for Korean and overseas markets, plus lookups on your own account. Read-only: it cannot place orders. A linked Korea Investment brokerage account and registered ID are required.
catalog.krx_market_dataSummary: Daily KOSPI and KOSDAQ prices straight from the exchange, up to 31 weekdays per read. A free KRX account needs approval for each market you use; verification checks both. Membership requires Korean identity verification by mobile phone or i-PIN.
catalog.alpha_vantage_market_dataSummary: Recent daily stock prices with a free Alpha Vantage account.
catalog.benzinga_newsSummary: Market news and corporate events. Getting a free key requires a phone number. News access depends on your license.
catalog.biztoc_newsSummary: Business and financial news. The RapidAPI Basic plan requires a payment card and may charge for excess bandwidth.
catalog.bls_macroSummary: BLS economic series; a key raises the public API limits. This connection requires a registered key for series. The public API allows 25 anonymous queries per day.
catalog.cftc_commitmentsSummary: Search Commitments of Traders reports without an account. To raise the shared request limit, create an optional app token in your Socrata profile.
catalog.econdb_macroSummary: International macroeconomic datasets. New accounts require a paid plan.
catalog.eia_energySummary: Official U.S. energy statistics and outlooks.
catalog.fmp_market_dataSummary: Global company, market, and fundamental data. Free Basic signup includes limited US quotes and up to 250 calls per day. Other data may require a paid plan.
catalog.fred_macroSummary: US and international economic series from the St. Louis Fed. Free personal key.
catalog.intrinio_market_dataSummary: Market prices, fundamentals, and estimates. Data access requires a paid plan. The individual trial requires a card and renews automatically.
catalog.nasdaq_data_linkSummary: Nasdaq datasets; a key unlocks authenticated datasets and higher limits. Signup requires reCAPTCHA and email activation.
catalog.openbb_platformSummary: Market, company, fund, options and economic data from public sources. Read-only, and no account or key needed.
catalog.openbb_platform_data_authority: The provider selected for each request
catalog.sec_edgarSummary: US company facts and filings, read straight from the SEC. Needs only a contact email.
catalog.tiingo_market_dataSummary: Equity, fund, crypto, and news data. Sign up, activate your account by email, then open your account’s API Token page.
catalog.tradier_market_dataSummary: Equity and options market data. Read-only: it cannot place trades. A Tradier brokerage account is required for both live and sandbox tokens.
catalog.tradingeconomics_macroSummary: Global economic calendars, indicators, forecasts, and markets. Personal API access is paid. The trial requires a payment method and renews automatically.
catalog.opendart_disclosuresSummary: Korean corporate disclosures and financial statements, straight from the official filing system. Free key.
catalog.community_web_researchSummary: Search the public web and read HTML, PDF, and Office sources. Usable for current research after a page is fetched.
catalog.community_web_research_data_authority: Current Chat provider hosted search, Exa, and original source publishers
catalog.community_web_research_attribution: Selected search provider and original source publishers
catalog.world_bank_indicatorsSummary: Global development and macroeconomic series, straight from the World Bank. No account needed.
catalog.defillama_tvlSummary: Daily value locked for on-chain protocols and networks, and stablecoin supply. No account needed.

readiness.unavailableNote: This connection couldn’t start. Loupist will try again on your next question. If this keeps happening, restart Loupist. Reinstall only if restarting doesn’t help.
